mode.title: Autofill Engine Mode
mode.aiDescription: Uses AI reasoning to interpret questions & match complex fields
mode.standardDescription: Direct profile attribute matching without AI calls

ai.title: AI Engine
ai.privacy: Privacy: Fields marked SENSITIVE are never sent to AI, only their labels. Values of AI SAFE fields and the form's questions are sent to {provider}.
ai.customHint: Works with any server that speaks the OpenAI chat API, such as OpenRouter, Groq, Mistral, Ollama or LM Studio. Local servers don't need a key.
ai.addKeyHint: Add your {provider} API key to use AI Smart Fill.
ai.proHint: Pro: unlimited AI fills. Your key stays in this browser.
ai.freeHint: Free plan: {limit} AI fills per week. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited.

guide.toggle: How do I get a key?
guide.optional: Optional: without a key, Standard Fill still fills forms by matching field names.

gemini.note: Free, no credit card needed. The easiest way to start.
gemini.step1: Click Open Google AI Studio below and sign in with your Google account.
gemini.step2: Click Create API key. If it asks for a project, pick any one or let it create one.
gemini.step3: Copy the key. It starts with AIza.
gemini.step4: Paste it in the box above. It is saved automatically, only in this browser.

openai.note: Paid: OpenAI charges per use, so add a little credit first (a few dollars lasts a long time).
openai.step1: Click Open OpenAI below and sign in, or create an account.
openai.step2: In Billing, add a payment method and some credit.
openai.step3: Open API keys, click Create new secret key and copy it. It starts with sk-.
openai.step4: Paste it in the box above. It is saved automatically, only in this browser.

anthropic.note: Paid: Anthropic charges per use, so buy a little credit first.
anthropic.step1: Click Open Claude Console below and sign in, or create an account.
anthropic.step3: Open API keys, click Create key and copy it. It starts with sk-ant-.
anthropic.step4: Paste it in the box above. It is saved automatically, only in this browser.

custom.note: For services like OpenRouter or Groq, or a model running on your own computer (Ollama, LM Studio).
custom.step1: Enter the server address, for example https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, or http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama.
custom.step2: Paste that service's API key. A server on your own computer usually needs none.
custom.step3: Type the model name the service uses, for example llama3.1.

paginate.title: Auto-Pagination
paginate.description: Fills each page, clicks Next / Continue, and presses Submit at the end. Corrects answers the form rejects; pauses when it can't.
paginate.upgrade: Upgrade to Pro to use Auto-Pagination

security.title: Encrypted Locally
security.descriptionDevice: AES-256, kept only in this browser. Each account and the guest have their own data, never shared. Anyone who uses this browser profile can open Aullevo, so use your own browser profile on a shared computer.

memories.title: AI Memories
memories.descriptionAiOn: Facts about you the AI can use to answer open questions (e.g. "Work style: remote only"). Enabled memories are sent to {provider} and stored unencrypted in this browser, so don't add passwords or ID numbers.
memories.descriptionAiOff: Facts about you the AI can use to answer open questions (e.g. "Work style: remote only"). Used only when AI Smart Fill is on. Enabled memories are sent to {provider} and stored unencrypted in this browser, so don't add passwords or ID numbers.
memories.enabledTitle: Memory is sent to the AI
memories.newContentPlaceholder: Content (e.g. Prefers fully remote roles, open to contract)

deviceData.title: Data on This Device
deviceData.description: Each account has its own encrypted vault here. Accounts never see each other's profiles, documents, API key, memories, or links.
deviceData.deleteTitle: Delete this account's data from this device
deviceData.confirmDelete:
Delete Aullevo data for "{name}" from this device?

This permanently removes its encrypted profiles, documents, API key, AI memories, and link queue. It cannot be undone.
